Name: IceBoxStorefront
Description: IceBoxStorefront Plugin - Steamworks integration for IceBoxEngine. Exposes the `Storefront` Lua API: achievements, stats, leaderboards, cloud saves, friends, rich presence, overlay, lobbies, P2P networking, voice, Workshop (create/update/query), DLC, auth tickets, screenshots, Steam Timeline, and Steam Input / Steam Deck / Steam Machine / Steam Frame support. Windows, Linux and macOS. Reads its AppId from steam_config.json in this folder or from the ICEBOX_STEAM_APPID environment variable. The Steamworks SDK is not included: download it from Valve and place the Steam runtime library beside this plugin. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve Corporation.
Author: IceBoxCrew
